translation:
Loss of blood from the beginning is heat making the calamity; new and old, deficiency and repletion one must examine in detail. With ascending and no descending, it appears in the upper part; yang sinking into the yin, the large and small intestine.
Yin deficiency with fire stirring comes to see blood; the method of treatment: supplement yin and moreover repress yang. Qi descending and blood returning, nothing is forgotten; Xijiao Dihuang Tang (Rhinoceros-Rehmannia Decoction) is not cool.
Xijiao Dihuang Tang is most efficacious; Danpi (Moutan Bark), Chishao (Red Peony), Huanglian (Coptis) and Huangqin (Scutellaria). Dang Gui, wine-processed, moreover should be used; what worry that lost blood does not return to its channels.

Guipi Tang (Spleen-Restoring Decoction) (with additions: Chaihu, Zhizi)
Renshen (Ginseng), Baizhu, Huangqi (Astragalus), Fuling, Longyanrou (Longan Flesh), Xingren each two qian, Yuanzhi (Polygala), Muxiang (Aucklandia), Fushen (Poria with hostwood), Dang Gui.
translator_notes: 犀角地黃湯=Xijiao Dihuang Tang; 歸脾湯=Guipi Tang.
陽陷陰中=yang sinking into the yin (interior).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The Classics say sweat is the fluid of the heart; much is from the heart and kidney not communicating. Spontaneous sweating like rain, fearing yang-collapse; yang deficient, yin abundant, it erupts into reversal illness.
Thief-sweat (daohan, night sweat), after sleeping it ceases at waking; yin deficient, yang interstices, fever extremely. These all are yin-yang each being partial in victory; there are moreover three kinds not-to-be-treated, speak in detail.
Sweat greasy like rain, fluids exhausted; sweat congealing like pearls and beans, blood and qi damaged. Sweat issuing like flowing, icy and insipid — Jianzhong Liangde (Build-the-Centre Two-Attainments) is best.

Jianzhong Liangde Tang (Build-the-Centre Two-Attainments Decoction)
Jianzhong Liangde (Build-the-Centre Two-Attainments) with Baizhu and Shao (Peony); Huangqi (Astragalus), Gancao (Licorice) and Fumai (Wheat) assembled. Mahuanggeng (Ephedra Root) one handful to decoct; treating sweat, it stops — truly a wonderful secret.
translator_notes: 汗乃心之液=sweat is the fluid of the heart.
自汗/盜汗=spontaneous vs night (thief) sweating.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Dizziness (xuan) without cause suddenly comas; deaf-ear and closed-eye can alarm and doubt. Like standing on a boat or cart, about to topple and fall; liver wind surging above with depletion below at the time.
Excess and deficiency both have this; in illness and after childbirth, treat each accordingly. Combined for phlegm, regulate as the good method; Qingyun Tangzi (Clear-Dizziness Beverage) is from ancient to modern a marvel.

Qingyun Tang (Clear-Dizziness Decoction)
Qingyun Tang with Huo (Qianghuo/Notopterygium), Ban (Pinellia) and Nanxing (Arisaema); Gancao (Licorice), Fuling, Zhi (Baizhi) and Xixin (Asarum). Chuanxiong, Huangqin, Chenpi and Fangfeng and Zhu (Atractylodes); allowing even dizziness, it keeps peace and tranquility.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
